summary: Iteration 2 testing: backend AI/quiz/lesson/admin/leaderboard/rewards/achievements endpoints all PASS (24/24 after retrying one 502 from k8s ingress timeout on AI quiz gen). Frontend: admin login, Admin Users CMS (12 users listed), Teacher Lessons CMS (3 lessons + Add button), Leaderboard (11 rows + 3 podium), Rewards page (6 items, both tabs), Islands -> Detail (3 subjects, 3 lessons), Lesson Viewer (video + content rendered, quiz appears after 'Darsni tugatdim' click as designed). AI Tutor toggle is rendered but the chat panel never becomes visible after clicking the floating button — likely z-index/overlap conflict with the 'Made with Emergent' badge or a React state/animation regression. minor.issue: Endpoint occasionally returns 502 from the Kubernetes ingress when Kimi takes >~60s. Backend itself is fine (succeeded on direct retry in ~42s). Consider streaming or shorter prompt to stay below ingress timeout.
Working but slow (~30-60s per response). UI must show a clear loading indicator and tolerate >60s waits.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking [data-testid="ai-tutor-toggle"] does NOT reveal [data-testid="ai-tutor-chat"]. Tested twice with force=True clicks (1.5s wait between) — panel never becomes visible. Likely causes: (a) z-50 of toggle/panel conflicts with the 'Made with Emergent' badge sitting at the same bottom-right corner; (b) AnimatePresence/motion.div animation never completes; (c) isOpen state not toggling. Manual reproduction recommended. End-to-end AI Tutor flow could therefore not be UI-verified, even though POST /api/ai/tutor works correctly from backend tests.
React console warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' — items rendered without proper key. Cosmetic but should be fixed.

Run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL set. The Kimi API takes 30-60s per call so allow generous timeouts. The main remaining bug is the AI Tutor floating chat panel not opening on click — verify in a real browser whether toggle.onClick is firing (check React DevTools or add a console.log to setIsOpen). The 'Made with Emergent' badge at bottom-right shares the corner with the toggle button.
rca of the issue: AI Tutor chat won't open: Playwright force-clicked [data-testid="ai-tutor-toggle"] twice with 1.5s between clicks; [data-testid="ai-tutor-chat"] never reached visible state. Hypotheses (in order of likelihood): (1) The Emergent badge iframe/div at bottom-right overlays the toggle and intercepts pointer events at the page level even though force-click bypasses Playwright's actionability check, because the browser dispatches the click to whatever element is topmost at those coordinates. Fix: reposition the AI tutor toggle (e.g., bottom-24 right-6) so it does not share the corner with the Emergent badge, OR raise z-index above the badge container. (2) AnimatePresence + motion.div not mounting due to a runtime error inside the chat (e.g., messages.map crash). Open browser DevTools to confirm. (3) setIsOpen not toggling because the button is wrapped by something that swallows events. Recommend repositioning first — that alone usually fixes it.
